items.title: Phil Schaap interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 9, 2003
items.q: there’s not a Jimi Hendrix memorial, it’s the Fletcher Henderson festival.

ctx.x: Yeah. I mean KCR had never popped up in his chart. So he had to go look in his FM code book to find it’s the Columbia University FM station. First of all FM stations didn’t pop up too often in the charts yet. So what are they doing? They had a Beatles festival? Whatever he thinks. First of all no, it’s not the Beatles, it’s not the Rolling Stones, there’s not a Jimi Hendrix memorial, it’s the Fletcher Henderson festival. Okay who’s Fletcher Henderson? He may be a coming pop college star. I better find out about…
